title: Executive Assistant - AI & Business Operations
description: Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD About Us We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes. Job Description As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business. Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track. You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed. You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted. Key Responsibilities Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up. Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early. Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers. Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions. Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed. Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up. Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists. Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors. Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues. Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible. Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality. Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination. Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used. Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion. Required Qualifications Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership. A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required. Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination. Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports. Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work. Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations. Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools. Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools. Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly. Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload. title: Sport science teacher
description: Company Description High school is an educational institution dedicated to providing inclusive, quality secondary education to learners from diverse backgrounds. The school focuses on strong academic foundations, personal development, and preparation for higher education and future careers. It promotes a supportive environment where students can grow intellectually, socially, and physically. Educators are encouraged to use modern teaching methods, collaborate with colleagues, and participate in school-wide initiatives. The school values professionalism, continuous learning, and positive engagement with students and families. Role Description The Sport Science Teacher is responsible for delivering engaging, curriculum-aligned lessons that integrate concepts from sport science, physics, and mathematics. This full-time, on-site role in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia includes planning and preparing lessons, assessing student progress, and providing constructive feedback to support learning. The teacher will design practical activities, demonstrations, and assessments that promote physical literacy, scientific understanding of movement, and healthy lifestyle choices. Daily responsibilities include maintaining a safe learning environment, recording grades, communicating with parents and guardians when needed, and collaborating with colleagues on cross-curricular projects. The role also involves participating in staff meetings, professional development, and school events related to sports and academic enrichment. Qualifications Strong background in Science Education, with the ability to teach Sport Science in a high school setting. Subject knowledge in Physics and Mathematics to integrate scientific and quantitative concepts into sport-related lessons. Qualified Teacher status or equivalent teaching certification, with experience teaching at the secondary level. Proficiency in Lesson Planning, including designing engaging, inclusive, and assessment-driven lessons. Excellent classroom management, communication, and interpersonal skills to support a diverse student body. Ability to create safe and inclusive practical learning environments, particularly in sports and physical activities. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Sport Science, Physical Education, Science Education, or a closely related field. Experience or interest in coaching school sports teams or leading extracurricular physical activities is an advantage. Commitment to continuous professional development and collaboration with colleagues and school leadership.MSC sprt sciene

title: Finance & Accounting Lead - Business Central Setup, AI Agents & Latvian Tax
description: Location: Fully remote Company: Latvia-based startup Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD. Engagement type: Full-time Working hours: Flexible About Us We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation. We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently. Job Description You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting. You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system. AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work. Key Responsibilities Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations. Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation. Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows. Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail. Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes. Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions. Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting. Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls. Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification. Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information. Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies. Required Qualifications Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries. Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage. Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration. The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly. Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors. Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data. Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder. Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements. A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience. Especially Valuable Experience Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small in

title: Cabin Engineer - Ethiopia Recruitment Event
description: Special Note – Ethiopia Recruitment Event This vacancy is linked to Air Arabia’s upcoming invitation-only Engineering Recruitment Event in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Candidates should apply to this vacancy only if they are available to attend the recruitment event in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia mid November 2026, subject to being shortlisted and invited by Air Arabia. Full event details, including venue, date, timing and interview schedule, will be shared only with shortlisted candidates prior to the event. If you are interested in similar Air Arabia opportunities but are not available to attend the Ethiopia event, please apply separately to the relevant non-event vacancy on the Air Arabia careers site. Job Purpose Carries out and supervises Cabin Appearance Base-level maintenance tasks on Air Arabia and Third-party aircraft within the corresponding License Category, ensuring the required work is performed, certified and recorded accurately and timely in accordance with Air Arabia and regulatory requirements. Key Result Responsibilities Operational Excellence Constantly verifies and ensures compatibility and readiness of cabin appearance components as per approved standards and quantity to be used as and when needed. Reviews assigned task cards with the Workshop Supervisor to gain full understanding of the work, priorities, documentation requirements and cautions, prior to starting work. Prepares and performs scheduled cabin appearance maintenance according to assigned task cards, ensuring feasibility and cost effectiveness; ensures that the required documentation, parts, tools and GSE are obtained and used per issued instructions (wherever applicable). Carries out component (cabin appearance) test and inspection tasks to the standard necessary to fully identify and record any defects or damage in accordance with approved maintenance procedures. Performs defect rectification in accordance with Aircraft Approved Data and instructions provided by the Engineering Department. Signs of maintenance tasks performed or supervised within the scope of own authorization, verifying that the task card and associated documents have been completed to the required standard following completion of all maintenance. Manages communications with other Engineers and Technicians related to the assigned tasks, ensuring proper coordination, continuity and handover of work Safety Manages the safety of assigned maintenance tasks, ensuring all published mandatory precautions are taken prior to commencing work and during task execution. Take positive steps to protect self and other people in the area of maintenance activity from any possible injury, including the use of proper GSE and protective equipment. Manages human factors aspects of maintenance, ensuring that the continuity of critical maintenance tasks is protected, by avoidance of task interruption and the proper use of handover procedures. Reputation And Teamwork Internal Customer Service: provides positive support to other operational teams in ABY, provides proactive and helpful professional advice, suggestions and solutions. Leadership: provides sound supervision and guidance to Technicians assigned to support their own tasks. Ensure they are adequately briefed to perform the non-certifying maintenance tasks. Representing Air Arabia: presents a positive and competent image of technical professionalism to ABY Flight Crews, other companies’ personnel and ABY customers. Cost Awareness Maintains positive awareness to the cost of aircraft maintenance including use of time and materials. Minimizes unnecessary waste of consumable material and part repair cost by avoiding unnecessary damage and repeat work during maintenance. Working Relationships/Communication. People Management Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development. Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team. Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures. Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages) Holds / has held a valid EASA/GCAA/CAA/ICAO Maintenance Engineer’s licence is an advantage. Ability to use a computer (Microsoft Office). Ability to obtain Driver’s License in work location. Ability to read, write, speak and understand English to a very good standard for technical communications. Work Experience Extensive working experience in similar role in a workshop. With at least 2 years’ experience qualified maintenance technician on the Airbus A320/A321 family of aircraft or at least 4 years’ experience in a Base Maintenance or Workshop Maintenance environment.

title: Junior to Mid-Level Accountant
description: Company Description System Elements provides digital solutions that streamline event registration, attendance tracking, and on-site and off-site visitor management. The company helps event organizers reduce manual administrative tasks and improve the overall attendee and visitor experience. Its platforms deliver accurate, real-time insights before, during, and after events, supporting data-driven decisions. System Elements focuses on efficient, user-friendly tools that make event and visitor operations more organized and reliable for clients of varying sizes. Role Description The Junior to Mid-Level Accountant is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. This role is responsible for recording daily financial transactions, maintaining accurate ledgers, and assisting with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities. The accountant will prepare routine financial reports, support monthly and annual closing activities, and help reconcile bank and system accounts. The role also involves supporting budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and company policies, and collaborating with internal teams to provide clear financial information. The individual will work closely with senior finance staff to improve financial processes and support audits as needed. Qualifications Strong foundation in accounting principles, including general ledger management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and basic tax concepts. Proficiency in accounting software and Excel, with the ability to work with spreadsheets, financial models, and reporting tools. Attention to detail, accuracy in data entry, and strong organizational skills for managing multiple financial tasks and deadlines. Analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, and recommend corrective actions. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and explain financial information clearly. Ability to work on-site in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and maintain a professional and ethical approach to handling confidential financial information. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications or progress toward them (e.g., ACCA, CPA) are an advantage. Prior experience in an accounting or finance role (internship or 1–3 years) is beneficial, especially in a technology or services-oriented company.

title: Senior Meteorologist and Lead excutiv in Gambella Meteoriology servise
description: Company Description The Ethiopian Meteorology Institute is a national institution responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and forecasting weather and climate conditions across Ethiopia. It provides critical meteorological information to support agriculture, disaster risk reduction, aviation, water resource management, and public safety. The Institute develops and maintains observation networks, forecasting systems, and climate services to inform decision-makers and communities. It works in close collaboration with regional offices, including the Gambella Meteorology Service, to deliver accurate, timely, and reliable weather and climate data. Role Description The Senior Meteorologist and Lead Executive for the Gambella Meteorology Service oversees regional forecasting operations, data analysis, and service delivery for the Gambella area while being based at the Ethiopian Meteorology Institute in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. This full-time, on-site role includes leading daily weather and climate monitoring, preparing and reviewing forecasts and advisories, and coordinating severe weather alerts for stakeholders and the public. The position manages communication with regional offices, government agencies, and partners, ensuring that meteorological information is clear, accurate, and actionable. The Senior Meteorologist also supervises and mentors staff, supports capacity-building activities, contributes to research and development of forecasting methods, and participates in strategic planning, reporting, and resource management for the Gambella Meteorology Service. Qualifications Strong foundation in Meteorology, with experience in operational forecasting and weather analysis. Knowledge of Severe Weather processes, including monitoring, early warning, and risk communication. Background in Climatology, with ability to interpret climate trends and support climate-related services. Understanding of Oceanography and its influence on regional weather and climate systems. Solid grasp of Physics principles relevant to atmospheric science and numerical weather prediction. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Physics, or a closely related field. Experience in leading teams, coordinating regional services, and managing projects or programs. Proficiency in meteorological software, data visualization tools, and numerical modeling systems. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and accuracy. Effective written and oral communication skills in English; proficiency in local languages is an advantage. Ability to work on-site in Addis Ababa and collaborate with regional offices and external stakeholders. Experience in disaster risk reduction, early warning systems, or climate services is a plus.
